sort and grade the flowers on the basis of appropriate parameters
bunch the flowers as per the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

modules.module_title: Prepare for pelleting the flower seeds

pcs.pc_description: select flower seeds with the required characteristics for pelleting
arrange the relevant PPE for the seed pelleting operation
arrange the recommended seed covering material such as talcum powder/ clay, adhesive and an active ingredient to prepare the coating formulation
prepare the coating formulation by mixing the covering material, adhesive and the active ingredient in the recommended quantity
fill in the tumbling drum/ rotary pan/ coating pan with the recommended quantity of flower seeds and coating formulation for pelleting
switch on and operate the tumbling drum/ rotary pan/ coating pan as per the manufacturer’s instructions
check the flower seeds during the operation regularly to ensure seeds achieve the required level of coating and weight
collect the pelleted flower seeds in a clean container
dry the seeds under the sun or using a dryer as appropriate
store the pelleted flower seeds as per the storage requirements
identify and purchase the appropriate packing material for the pelleted flower seeds such as air-tight polythene pouches or paper pouches
pack the pelleted flower seeds as per the SOP
maintain the record of the seeds pelleted and packed
maintain the relevant health and safety standards while handling seeds
segregate waste into different categories
dispose the non-recyclable waste appropriately
deposit the recyclable and reusable material at the identified location
